derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of G5443 (φυλή);
def: a co-tribesman, i.e. native of the same country

occurrences.text: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
